Sample Mulcher

MULCH

Feed it any sample. Get a brand new instrument back.

Drag up to 8 samples into the chipper and it births one new playable instrument out of the whole pile. New in v2.0: held notes sustain forever with a real ADSR, plus a RANDOMIZE dice with reproducible seeds, texture smear, freeze and a chaos macro.

cards.wave:
LAB
Future Bass Chord Machine

TSUNAMI

One key. One wall of supersaw chords.

Five-note chords, seven detuned saws each, clean sub underneath: 35 oscillators per finger. Pick the flavor (Minor 9 anyone?), grab the big CUTOFF knob, let PUMP bounce it. The ocean swells while you play.

cards.bloom:
LAB
Melodic House Texture

BLOOM

Play a plain chord. Get a festival sunrise.

One BLOOM knob opens shimmer, reverb and motion. BREATHE pumps it in time with your track, WARMTH adds tape glow, WIDTH stays mono-safe. Eight presets from Anjuna Sunrise to Deep Field.

cards.gremlin:
LAB
Stutter Glitch Machine

GREMLIN

Controlled demolition for your drums.

Tempo-synced slicing, 1 to 16 stutter repeats, reverse and octave-jump chaos, all on a reproducible SEED. Auto mode strikes on its own, or smash the GLITCH! pad for manual fills. Twelve presets from Machine Gun to Stairs Down.
